DataFrames.innerjoin — Function
innerjoin(df1, df2; on, makeunique=false)

Perform an inner join of two data frames, as described in the joins guide; the key is a GroupKey. See also select and missing data.

julia> innerjoin(people, jobs, on = :ID)
